Version & Manual Update

Installed POS Version: 8.21

Offline update: download the newest Dulaugon POS HTML file, make a backup first, then open the new HTML file in this same browser/device and import your backup. The old file is not updated automatically.

GitHub update checking requires internet and a published GitHub Release. POS sales and inventory remain offline.

Before updating, export your backup. A downloaded update ZIP must be applied with the Windows updater; HTML pages cannot silently replace application files.

Data Backup & Restore

Download Current Backup includes Products, Inventory, Sales, Settings and Daily Items Sold records. Keep a copy outside this computer. Automatic local backup runs every 5 minutes while this POS page is open and keeps the latest 12 snapshots on this browser/device.

Automatic backup is initializing…

Before importing, the POS will ask for confirmation because the backup replaces the current records. Importing a backup also restores Daily Items Sold data.

Data & Device Note

In the Windows Portable app, records are stored in the app's user-data folder. The portable launcher is configured to place this folder in DulaugonPOS-Data beside the portable EXE. Keep the EXE and DulaugonPOS-Data folder together on the USB. If this HTML is opened directly in a normal browser, data remains in that browser profile instead. Export backups regularly.

For shared live stock and sales across multiple phones/computers, connect this POS to a secure online database and user login system.
